title: The Art of Branching: Cobordism Junctions of 10d String Theories
summary: We describe the explicit construction of configurations of several 10d string theories joining at a 9d junction, providing a dynamical realization of cobordisms between multiple 10d string theories, predicted by the Cobordism Conjecture. We provide the microscopic worldsheet description of the configuration in a generalization of the `going up and down the RG flow' interpolations recently used in the description of IIA/IIB domain wall.
